articles.title: How Circle’s institutional Arc blockchain got taken over by memecoins on day one
articles.snippet: Circle blockchain Arc's first day was dominated by memecoins, and the traders behind them had already moved on by Thursday morning.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin edges higher as Nasdaq climbs 1.7% in wake of Fed rate hike
articles.snippet: The SEC debuted its long-awaited "innovation exemption," providing a roadmap for blockchain-based venues to offer tokenized securities.

articles.title: Crypto rallies through the Fed's first rate increase since 2023
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rose 0.88% over 24 hours to $76,621 as the central bank's projections implied only one further hike. Zcash jumped 23% to a record after Paradigm disclosed a stake.

articles.title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
articles.snippet: The Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act would ease complicated tax burdens for everyday use of cryptocurrencies, though Trump's industry ties spurred some pushback.

articles.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
articles.snippet: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.
